messages:
Maya: quick ping — PR #33121 (ledger toggle) is ready for review but CI keeps hitting an intermittent failure on tests/integration/ledger_sync_test. need 1 approval to make the next deploy window. :eyes:
Devin: on it, can you drop the PR link? I'll skim the change, if it's tiny i can approve after a clean rerun.
Maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/33121 — 4-line change: feature flag toggle + guard. failing job is `integ-linux-shard3`.
CI Bot: integ-linux-shard3 — failed — job exited with code 1
CI Bot: ```
--- FAIL: TestLedgerSync (0.23s)
    sync_test.go:112: expected 42 entries, got 0
    error: timeout waiting for db ready after 30s
```
Sree: i've seen this exact symptom on shard3 before — infra latency. usually a targeted rerun clears it. recommend `/rerun integ-linux-shard3` rather than changing snapshots.
Olga: agree with @Sree. don't update snapshots for a transient timeout. also wallet: the guard looks fine but it could be a timing window. can you add a tiny retry/backoff? if rerun passes i'll approve.
Maya: pushed commit 2 adding a 50ms backoff + one retry in the test harness (small change). kicking a targeted rerun now.
CI Bot: rerun requested by Maya — queued integ-linux-shard3 (rerun #1)
Ben: i can give the approval once rerun is green. if it flakes again let's triage tomorrow morning and consider marking the test flaky instead of blocking the pipeline. :thumbsup:
Devin: small procedural note — if a test flakes >3 times in 24h, please open a flake ticket and add `flake:investigate` label so it won't gate merges.
Maya: noted — will watch rerun and open a ticket if it repeats. thanks all.
Olga: :shipit: pending green rerun.
CI Bot: integ-linux-shard3 (rerun #1) — PASSED
Maya: thanks — @Ben, @Olga feel free to approve when you have a sec. merging after approvals.
